title: Paint House II
description: Paint n houses with k colors such that no two adjacent houses have the same color, minimizing total cost.

steps.note: Processing house 1, color 0. Min previous is 3 (color 2). cost[1][0] += 3 = 5
Processing house 1, color 1. Min previous is 1 (color 0). cost[1][1] += 1 = 10
Processing house 1, color 2. Min previous is 1 (color 0). cost[1][2] += 1 = 5
